text:
Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can paint pictures, compose music, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by these machines, while others worry that they will replace human artists.

However, true creativity involves emotions, personal experiences, and intuition. A machine can imitate a style or combine patterns, but it cannot feel joy, sadness, or love. It never knows what it is like to fall in love or lose a friend. So, AI-generated art may look beautiful, but it lacks the deep meaning that comes from human life.

Instead of replacing us, AI can be a helpful tool. It can inspire us, save time, and offer new ideas. The best results come when humans and machines work together, mixing imagination with technology.
